full_name: Dimitrios Psaltis | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Physical Sciences Shutzer Fellow University of Arizona
bio: Dimitrios Psaltis is a professor of astronomy and physics at the University of Arizona. He specializes in Einstein's General Theory of Relativity and its implication for black holes and neutron stars. Psaltis is one of the key members of the Event Horizon Telescope, which will obtain the first ever picture of an astrophysical black hole.
